title: Kekova Sea Kayaking vs Private Wooden Boat: Which Experience Fits You?
seoTitle: Kekova Sea Kayaking vs Private Wooden Boat Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Compare Kekova sea kayaking from Üçağız with a private wooden boat: Sunken City conservation rules, fitness needs, family comfort, and gear lists.
quickAnswer: Choose guided sea kayaking from Üçağız for silent, eye-level views just meters off Kekova's Sunken City shoreline in calm morning water. Choose a private wooden boat when traveling with young children, older relatives, or during July–August heatwaves, when a shaded deck, swim ladder, and freshly cooked onboard lunch matter most.

body.text: How close do sea kayaks paddle to the Kekova Sunken City ruins?

Because shallow-draft sea kayaks need almost no depth and create zero engine wake, guides lead paddlers smoothly within a few meters of Kekova Island's northern shoreline. You peer directly down into clear water at submerged Lycian staircases, harbour walls, and amphora shards without landing, anchoring, or swimming over the ruins.

The Kekova Specially Protected Area strictly prohibits swimming, snorkeling, scuba diving, and landing directly over the [Sunken City of Dolchiste](https://kaspeninsulagardens.com/discover-kekova-sunken-city-your-ultimate-guide-to-turkeys-underwater-lycian-wonder-from-kas/), which slipped beneath the Mediterranean during second-century CE earthquakes. Larger motorized tour boats must idle farther offshore to avoid wash damage, whereas kayaks glide silently right beside the coastal rock-cut foundations. Swimming and snorkeling remain permitted at designated nearby bays, including Tersane (Shipyard) Bay and Aquarium Bay, before stopping at car-free Kaleköy to climb [Simena Castle (€4 in 2026)](https://www.adayachtsailing.com/en/blog/where-is-simena-kalekoy-and-how-to-get-there-kalekoy-travel-guide).
What fitness level is required for a half-day guided kayak tour from Üçağız?

A standard half-day guided sea kayak trip from Üçağız requires only moderate everyday fitness—comparable to a steady, brisk two-hour walk—with zero prior paddling experience needed. Stable sit-on-top or touring kayaks, calm sheltered sound waters, and a motorized support vessel make the four-hour loop accessible to most healthy beginners.

Most morning departures launch from [Üçağız harbour around 09:00 and return by 13:00](https://kekovatourkey.com/product/kekova-sea-kayaking-guided/), breaking the paddling into relaxed 35-to-45-minute legs separated by a swim stop at Tersane Bay, a slow drift past the Sunken City, and a 45-minute shore break at Kaleköy (Simena). Operators routinely send a [motorized escort boat](https://www.kekovatour.com/en/aktivite-detay/kano-turlari) carrying dry bags, drinking water, and backup seating in case anyone tires or afternoon thermal breezes pick up.

body.text: When is a private wooden boat better for families or hot July days?

A private wooden boat beats kayaking whenever midday temperatures exceed 34°C, your group includes children under eight or non-swimmers, or you prefer four unhurried swim stops over paddling. You get full deck shade, a marine toilet, a stern swim ladder, and a freshly grilled lunch served at anchor.

In July and August, reflected UV glare off the Kekova sound turns open-cockpit paddling tiring by 11:30. Chartering a [private wooden boat from Üçağız](https://tur.tr/en/kas-kekova-boat-tour.html) puts you inside the sheltered sound in ten minutes—avoiding the longer open-sea crossing from Kaş—and lets your captain time Aquarium Bay, Tersane Bay, and Kaleköy around the larger shared day-boats. If half your group wants to paddle and half prefers shade, some Üçağız charters carry a kayak on deck for short cove paddles at permitted anchorages.
What waterproof gear and sun protection are essential?

For sea kayaking, pack a long-sleeve UPF 50+ rash guard, polarized sunglasses on a floating strap, a brimmed sun hat with a chin cord, reef-safe SPF 50 sunscreen, and water shoes for rocky bay landings. Keep phones inside a tested IPX8 waterproof pouch or dry bag rather than loose cockpit pockets.
Even on a shaded wooden boat, Mediterranean UV reflection burns exposed shoulders quickly:

items: UPF Swim Shirt & Hat: Essential for kayaking where your arms and knees sit in direct sun for hours.
Dry Bag (5–10L) & Phone Lanyard: Protects cameras, car keys, and cash for Kaleköy's €4 castle ticket and homemade goat-milk ice cream.
Water Shoes or Sandals: Rocky limestone entries at Tersane Bay and stepped stone paths up to Simena Castle punish bare feet.
1.5L Reusable Water Bottle: Operators provide drinking water, but having an insulated bottle clipped to your cockpit prevents dehydration.
Microfiber Towel & Light Dry Shirt: Useful for the breezy return drive from Üçağız back to Kaş (45 minutes).

faq.q: Are you allowed to swim or snorkel over the Kekova Sunken City?
faq.a: No. Swimming, snorkeling, scuba diving, and landing directly over the Sunken City of Dolchiste are strictly prohibited to protect the submerged Lycian ruins. Swimming is permitted in designated nearby bays like Tersane Bay and Aquarium Bay.

faq.q: Is it better to depart for Kekova from Üçağız or Kaş?
faq.a: Üçağız is the closest harbour to the Sunken City and Simena, making it ideal for half-day kayaking or shorter private boat trips. Kaş departures run 6 to 7 hours and suit travelers wanting a full-day coastal cruise without driving to Üçağız.

faq.q: Do I need prior kayaking experience for Kekova?
faq.a: No. Guided Üçağız kayak tours begin with a shore safety and paddle briefing, use stable kayaks in sheltered water, and include a motorized escort boat.

faq.q: How much is the entry fee for Simena Castle in Kaleköy in 2026?
faq.a: In 2026, admission to Simena Castle and its rock-cut theatre at the top of Kaleköy costs €4 for foreign visitors (Müzekart is valid for Turkish citizens).

faq.q: Can young children join a Kekova sea kayaking tour?
faq.a: Most operators accept children aged 6 to 8 and older seated in a double kayak with a parent, depending on sea conditions. For toddlers or mixed-age families, a shaded private wooden boat is far safer and more comfortable.

faq.q: What time of day has the calmest water for Kekova kayaking?
faq.a: Morning departures between 08:30 and 09:30 offer the flattest, clearest water for viewing submerged ruins before afternoon thermal breezes ripple the surface.
